title: Distance Is Not Enough: Forget-Retain Alignment Gap Predicts LLM Relearning Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2608.25429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to make a model forget specific data, yet unlearned LLMs often fail to stay unlearned: brief fine-tuning can revive removed knowledge. Existing robustness predictors rely on global weight-space displacement, but distance alone can be misleading when random or destructive updates collapse performance. We argue that relearning robustness depends on update structure: robust unlearning should affect forget-critical weights while sparing retain-critical ones. We introduce the Forget-Retain Alignment Gap (FRAG), a training-free predictor that scores an update's forget-retain alignment without running a relearning attack, and separates selective from dense updates more reliably than global distance. Building on the forget-critical, retain-sparing principle, Forget-Retain Pruning (FRP) improves relearning robustness. Our results suggest that weight selectivity better explains robustness than distance alone. Code is avai

translated_title: 距离并非一切：遗忘-保留对齐差距预测大语言模型再学习鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在使模型遗忘特定数据，然而经过遗忘处理的大语言模型往往难以保持遗忘状态：短暂的微调即可复活已删除的知识。现有的鲁棒性预测器依赖全局权重空间位移，但仅凭距离可能在随机或破坏性更新导致性能崩溃时产生误导。我们认为再学习鲁棒性取决于更新结构：稳健的遗忘应影响遗忘关键权重，同时保留保留关键权重。我们引入了遗忘-保留对齐差距（FRAG），这是一种无需训练的预测器，可在不运行再学习攻击的情况下评估更新的遗忘-保留对齐程度，并且比全局距离更可靠地区分选择性更新与密集更新。基于遗忘关键、保留关键的原则，遗忘-保留剪枝（FRP）提升了再学习鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，权重选择性比距离本身更能解释鲁棒性。代码已提供。
tldr: 本文提出遗忘-保留对齐差距（FRAG）和遗忘-保留剪枝（FRP），证明权重选择性比全局距离更能预测和提升大语言模型再学习鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Forget-Retain Alignment Gap (FRAG) and Forget-Retain Pruning (FRP), demonstrating that weight selectivity predicts and improves LLM relearning robustness better than global distance alone.
